events.source_displayed_time: SEC 8-K accepted 2024-03-08 07:10:02 ET (Item 7.01/8.01/9.01, EX-99.1 press release attached; investor call held same day at 8:00 a.m. ET)
events.notes: Global Phase 3 PHOENIX trial (664 ALS patients) of AMX0035 did not meet its prespecified primary endpoint (ALSFRS-R change from baseline, p=0.667) or any secondary endpoint. Amylyx subsequently withdrew RELYVRIO/ALBRIOZA from the market in April 2024. Release did not carry its own HH:MM dateline; the SEC 8-K acceptance timestamp (07:10:02 ET, pre-market) is used as the primary-source clock, matching the EXACT_TO_MINUTE_SEC_ACCEPTANCE_PROXY convention already used elsewhere in this pool (e.g. NEG-P3-2018-VTVT-STEADFAST).

FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for the govorestat NDA for Classic Galactosemia, disclosed in an Item 8.01 8-K filed after market close (16:21:25 ET, so the same-day 2024-11-27 session is used as the pre-event cutoff per the after-close rule). This is a separate, later, distinct negative catalyst from an earlier April 2023 topline readout for the same asset in a related indication (not sourced here); the CRL is the cleaner, unambiguous negative regulatory event.
